description: This pie chart illustrates a comparison of time components, specifically divided into two categories. The chart consists of a total of two slices, with categorical labels positioned just outside the pie and specific numerical values alongside percentages displayed directly inside each segment. The larger slice, colored orange and labeled "Reduction," accounts for 60.9s (69.92%) of the total. The smaller slice, colored blue and labeled "Efficient deployment," represents 26.2s (30.08%). The blue "Efficient deployment" segment is visually emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the main body of the pie chart. There is no separate legend included, as all necessary identification is provided through direct labeling adjacent to the slices.
caption_used: Efficient deployment methods significantly reduce the time cost, with the average total time cost before efficient deployment being 92.5s (30.5s + 62s). This represents a reduction of approximately 72.5% after efficient deployment, highlighting the substantial impact of optimization strategies.
